name: Telegram
effort: Make a bot, about five minutes
summary: Free · a private chat with a bot you create
help: In Telegram, message @BotFather to create a bot and copy its token. Send your bot a message, then enter the chat number it shows you.
what_leaves: The alert text goes to Telegram's servers and appears in the chat with your bot.

fields.label: Chat number
fields.help: The number of the chat the bot should write to.
